    name = EXCLUDED.name,
    state = EXCLUDED.state,

)
INSERT INTO gitmetrics.project_members (project_id, user_id, access_level, created_at)
VALUES (
  (SELECT p.id FROM gitmetrics.projects p WHERE p.gitlab_id = {{ $node["Get_Projects"].json["id"] }}),
  (SELECT user_db_id FROM upsert_user),
  NOW(),
  {{ $json.access_level }}
)
ON CONFLICT (project_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET
  access_level = EXCLUDED.access_level;

INSERT INTO gitmetrics.daily_user_metrics (
  metric_date, project_id, user_id, commits_count,
  merge_requests_opened, merge_requests_merged, estimated_hours
)
SELECT
  d.metric_date,
  d.project_id,
  d.user_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.commit_id) AS commits_count,
  COALESCE(m.mr_opened, 0) AS merge_requests_opened,
  COALESCE(m.mr_merged, 0) AS merge_requests_merged,
  LEAST(12, GREATEST(1, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(d.committed_at) - MIN(d.committed_at)))/3600.0)) AS estimated_hours
FROM (
  SELECT
    DATE(c.committed_date) AS metric_date,
    c.project_id,
    u.id AS user_id,
    c.id AS commit_id,
    c.committed_date AS committed_at
  FROM gitmetrics.commits c
  LEFT JOIN gitmetrics.users u ON c.author_name = u.name
  WHERE committed_date::date = CURRENT_DATE
) d
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    DATE(created_at) AS metric_date,
    project_id,
    author_id AS user_id,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state IN ('opened', 'reopened')) AS mr_opened,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'merged') AS mr_merged
  FROM gitmetrics.merge_requests
  WHERE created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
) m
  ON d.metric_date = m.metric_date AND d.project_id = m.project_id AND d.user_id = m.user_id
GROUP BY d.metric_date, d.project_id, d.user_id, m.mr_opened, m.mr_merged
ON CONFLICT (metric_date, project_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET
  commits_count = EXCLUDED.commits_count,
  merge_requests_opened = EXCLUDED.merge_requests_opened,
  merge_requests_merged = EXCLUDED.merge_requests_merged,
  estimated_hours = EXCLUDED.estimated_hours;
